parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of Unicode method names causing UnicodeDecodeError in Python 2.7.2. However, it introduces a potential regression risk by converting all method names to strings, which may not be suitable for all cases.

issues.description: The patch converts the method name to a string using `str(method)`, which may not be appropriate if `method` is already a byte string. This could lead to unexpected behavior or errors in other parts of the codebase.
